host_control.selection: Select once from permitted CPUs by lowest physical-package/core/CPU tuple where topology is available, otherwise first permitted CPU. Record actual selection.
host_control.application: Apply identical selected affinity to every measured child; fail closed on unsupported/invalid/mismatched controls.
host_control.limitations: CPU affinity does not reserve a physical core or isolate Redis/background activity.
host_control.telemetry: Capture pre/post process, GC and cgroup/host observations outside measured scopes; retain exact helper/controller hashes.

artifact_policy: Build all SDK/companion wheels before timing; install outside workspace, freeze source/artifacts and stop local benchmark/test interference.
prior_attempt_policy: All prior failures remain immutable evidence; host-control changes do not retroactively qualify old builds or erase instability.
publication: All four Rust companions remain unpublished; no native tags/releases/publication in this task.
